title: Northgate+ Annual Money-Back Window on Cancellation
content:
**Rule.** On an immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Annual membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships handled by the annual cancellation schedule, the refund core turns on how recently the annual fee was charged and on the benefit uses recorded since. The window is the tier's annual full refund window: 30 calendar days on Northgate+ Annual. A fee was "charged no more than 30 days before the cancellation date" when the calendar days from the fee charge date to the cancellation date number 30 or fewer.

| Fee charged no more than 30 days before the cancellation date | A benefit use dated on or after the charge date | Refund core |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | the whole fee |
| yes | yes | the whole fee less the value of the benefit uses dated within the one whole calendar month before the cancellation date, never less than the prorated fee |
| no | either | not set by this rule |

The value of a benefit use is the amount recorded on that use, the fee the member avoided. A benefit use is dated within the one whole calendar month before the cancellation date when less than one whole calendar month has passed from its date to the cancellation date. The prorated fee is the fee multiplied by the whole calendar months from the cancellation date to the renewal date, divided by the paid term in months.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical fee charged on 2 January 2032)**

| Cancellation date | Days since the charge | Within 30 days |
|---|---|---|
| 1 February 2032 | 30 | yes |
| 2 February 2032 | 31 | no |

**Worked case (hypothetical figures; fee 120.00, prorated fee 110.00)**

- Benefit uses of 4.00 and 3.00 dated within the month before cancellation, and the fee charged 20 days earlier: the refund core is 120.00 less 7.00, that is 113.00, which is not below the prorated fee.
- Benefit uses within that month worth 15.00: 120.00 less 15.00 is 105.00, below the prorated fee, so the refund core is 110.00.
